description: S4: equal-budget tuned table. Families whose S3 selection differs from the S1 configuration (B1 and B2 LSTMs, selected lr 0.01) are rerun with seeds 0-4 on the full 80/20 training block and evaluated on test. All other families selected the exact S1 configuration (lr 1e-3; N=4; ridge alpha 1.0), so their S1 runs are reused.
